findings.why_it_matters: The printed single seven-row list of exception-names and their I-O status first digits (9.1.12) is split in the markdown into two two-row tables (whose first rows become table headers) around an indented plain-text block of three entries. All seven pairs survive, but the one mapping is broken into three pieces, so a reader or a tool parsing the table sees only four entries (with two of them as headers) and misses EC-I-O-PERMANENT-ERROR, EC-I-O-LOGIC-ERROR and EC-I-O-RECORD-OPERATION.
